impact.animal-request: This is an active population request. Your response can change the animals in your collection and your future relationship with {zoo}.
impact.transfer-opportunity: This is a live transfer opportunity. Your response can change both the population involved and your future cooperation with {zoo}.
impact.population-cooperation: This offer can repair the sex structure of one of your managed populations, and responding to it feeds back into your relationship with {zoo}.
impact.player-zoo-birth: The newborn animals have already been added to the population and now count toward its managed group structure.
impact.welfare-zoo-concern: Trust with {zoo} has been reduced by the unresolved husbandry concern.
impact.welfare-protest: Public criticism is temporarily reducing visitor demand.
impact.grounds-expansion-approval: A real grounds-expansion credit has been added and can be spent with the enclosure builder.
impact.programme-update: This contact has increased your working familiarity with {zoo}, which affects later requests and opportunities.
impact.collection-planning: This contact has increased your working familiarity with {zoo}, which affects later requests and opportunities.
impact.network-contact: This contact has increased your working familiarity with {zoo}, which affects later requests and opportunities.
impact.daily-zoo-update: This daily development has applied a short-lived zoo modifier.
impact.husbandry-exchange: Practical knowledge from {zoo} has strengthened the relationship and, when you keep {species}, temporarily improves that population’s breeding prospects.
impact.publicity-feature: The feature has strengthened contact with {zoo} and is giving visitor demand a small short-lived lift.
impact.population-advice: The population-management discussion has increased trust and familiarity with {zoo}, improving the basis for later cooperation.
impact.population-pressure: This population needs an active management decision rather than being left as a passive notification.

breeding_observation.title: Promising behaviour
messages: Keepers have noticed encouraging breeding behaviour from the {species} population.
The {species} have been showing unusually promising courtship behaviour today.
Keeper observations suggest the {species} are entering a particularly favourable breeding period.
details: The husbandry team believes conditions are favourable over the coming week. Nothing is guaranteed, but the signs are encouraging.
Staff will keep disturbance around the group low while these behaviours continue.
breeding_observation.impact: For the next seven zoo days, this {species} population has an increased chance of producing young.

visitor_word_of_mouth.title: A good day out
messages: Visitors have responded particularly positively to today's zoo experience.
A run of enthusiastic visitor comments is spreading beyond the gates.
Today's visitors are leaving the zoo with unusually positive impressions.
details: Favourable word of mouth is beginning to spread locally.
The effect is modest, but tomorrow's attendance may benefit from today's response.
visitor_word_of_mouth.impact: Positive word of mouth is giving visitor demand a small lift into the next zoo day.

visitor_favourite.title: A visitor favourite
messages: Visitors have been lingering around the {species} noticeably longer than usual.
The {species} have become one of today’s most talked-about stops in the zoo.
Visitor attention has gathered around the {species}, with unusually enthusiastic reactions throughout the day.
details: The attention is beginning to carry beyond today’s visitors as people recommend the zoo to others.
Staff are hearing the same exhibit mentioned repeatedly in positive visitor feedback.
visitor_favourite.impact: Interest in the {species} is giving visitor demand a modest lift for the next two zoo days.

local_press_feature.title: Local attention
messages: A local feature has highlighted {zoo} and its work with {species}.
The {species} have drawn local media attention to {zoo}.
A small piece of local coverage has put {zoo} and its {species} population in the public eye.
details: The coverage does not change the zoo itself, but more people are now hearing about what has already been achieved.
Public awareness is catching up with developments that regular visitors and staff already know well.
local_press_feature.impact: For the next three zoo days, public reputation will catch up with the zoo’s underlying prestige more quickly.

population_pressure.title: Population pressure
messages: Keepers have flagged the {species} population for a management review.
The {species} group has reached a point where keepers want a clear population plan.
details: The group can remain together for now, but continuing without a plan risks increasing pressure on its social structure.
Staff recommend deciding whether to ease breeding pressure internally or involve the wider zoo network.
population_pressure.impact: This population now needs a management decision. You can ease breeding pressure or ask another zoo for population-management advice.

crowded_day.title: A very busy day
messages: Yesterday brought unusually heavy visitor numbers to {zoo}.
The zoo is still feeling the effects of an exceptionally busy visitor day.
details: The extra footfall was welcome, but congestion and queues have slightly softened immediate word of mouth.
crowded_day.impact: Visitor demand is slightly lower for the next zoo day while the effects of the crowding fade.

visitor_disappointment.title: A quieter response
messages: Visitor feedback around the {species} has been more muted than usual.
The {species} have drawn less visitor attention than staff expected today.
details: Nothing is wrong with the animals or their care; this is a short-lived change in visitor interest rather than a welfare concern.
visitor_disappointment.impact: Short-term visitor demand is slightly reduced into the next zoo day.

breeding-success.title: Breeding success
breeding-success.message: {zoo} has had a successful breeding season and is looking for a suitable new home for {animal} {pop}.
breeding-success.detail: {zoo} contacted your zoo about {animal} following a successful breeding season. The population is now available for transfer.

priority-contact.title: Partner zoo opportunity
priority-contact.message: {zoo} has contacted you directly about {animal} {pop} before pursuing other placements.
priority-contact.detail: Your {stage} relationship with {zoo} made your zoo a natural institution to contact about this {animal} population.

emergency-placement.title: Placement requested
emergency-placement.message: {zoo} is seeking a suitable institution for {animal} {pop} on relatively short notice.
emergency-placement.detail: A change in population management at {zoo} has created a time-sensitive placement opportunity for {animal}.

transfer-opportunity.title: Transfer opportunity
transfer-opportunity.detail: {zoo} is looking for an appropriate new holder for this {animal} population.

programme-update.title: Breeding programme update
programme-update.message: {zoo} has shared an update about its work with {species}.
programme-update.detail: The population is being retained for the moment while the zoo reviews its breeding plans. Staying in contact may create an opportunity later.
programme-update.impact: Being kept inside the programme discussion has improved your working familiarity with {zoo}; that relationship now carries into future breeding and transfer contacts.

collection-planning.title: Collection plans changing
collection-planning.message: {zoo} is reviewing the future of its {species} population.
collection-planning.detail: No animals are being offered yet. The collection team expects to make a decision after its current planning round.
collection-planning.impact: Your collection teams are now in closer contact with {zoo}. That familiarity will influence future requests and transfer opportunities.

network-contact.title: Zoo network contact
network-contact.detail: The zoo is sounding out institutions in its network before making any formal transfer plans. Your previous contact may matter if the situation develops.
network-contact.impact: The direct contact has strengthened your working relationship with {zoo}, making future cooperation a little more likely.

husbandry-exchange.title: Keeper knowledge exchange
husbandry-exchange.message: Keepers from {zoo} have shared recent husbandry observations concerning {species}.
husbandry-exchange.detail: The exchange covers practical management and breeding observations gathered from their own population.
husbandry-exchange.impact: The exchange has strengthened your relationship with {zoo}. If you currently keep {species}, your team can apply the new husbandry knowledge over the coming days.

publicity-feature.title: Zoo network feature
publicity-feature.message: {zoo} has included your zoo in a public story about institutions working with {species}.
publicity-feature.detail: The mention is modest, but it has put your collection in front of visitors who follow zoo and conservation news.
publicity-feature.impact: The feature has strengthened contact with {zoo} and is giving visitor demand a small lift for the next two zoo days.

population-advice.title: Population management discussion
population-advice.message: The collection team at {zoo} has asked to compare notes about the long-term management of {species}.
population-advice.detail: No transfer is being proposed yet. The discussion is about population structure, future breeding and where cooperation might be useful.
population-advice.impact: The substantive discussion has increased trust and familiarity with {zoo}, improving the basis for future requests and transfers.

surplus_relief.title: {zoo} offers to take surplus {species}
surplus_relief.message: {zoo} has noticed that your {species} population has grown beyond its preferred managed group size and can take {population} individuals.
surplus_relief.detail: Their collection team can absorb these animals without creating the same group-size problem at {zoo}. The suggested transfer is sized to bring your population back toward its normal managed range.
surplus_relief.impact: Sending the suggested individuals will reduce your {species} population toward a suitable group size and strengthen your working relationship with {zoo}.
